## Server-Side Pageview Collection

Track pageviews from your server using middleware. Recommended as a supplement to client-side tracking, configured in a separate source to isolate server data.

### Key Requirements

- **Share `anonymousId` across client and server:** Read and respect the `ajs_anonymous_id` cookie if present; set it (e.g., via UUID) if missing
- **Preserve userId:** Read from `ajs_user_id` cookie if the user is authenticated
- **Pass required context fields:** `ip`, `userAgent` (from request headers)
- **Pass required property fields:** `url`, `path`, `host`, `title`, `search`, `referrer`
- **Extract campaign data:** Map UTM parameters (`utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_content`, `utm_term`) into a `campaign` object

### UTM Parameter Mapping

| UTM Parameter   | Campaign Field |
|-----------------|----------------|
| `utm_source`    | `source`       |
| `utm_medium`    | `medium`       |
| `utm_campaign`  | `name`         |
| `utm_content`   | `content`      |
| `utm_term`      | `keyword`      |

### analytics.page() Signature

```js
analytics.page(anonymousId, userId, properties, context)
```

- `anonymousId`: string (required; from `ajs_anonymous_id` cookie or generated UUID)
- `userId`: string or null (from `ajs_user_id` cookie if authenticated)
- `properties`: object with `url`, `path`, `host`, `title`, `search`, `referrer`
- `context`: object with `campaign`, `userAgent`, `ip`

### Express Middleware Example

```js
import express from 'express'
import Analytics from 'analytics-node'
import { stringify } from 'qs'

const app = express()
const analytics = new Analytics('write-key')

app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const { search, cookies, url, path, ip, host } = req

  // populate campaign object with any utm params
  const campaign = {}
  if (search.utm_content) campaign.content = search.utm_content
  if (search.utm_campaign) campaign.name = search.utm_campaign
  if (search.utm_medium) campaign.medium = search.utm_medium
  if (search.utm_source) campaign.source = search.utm_source
  if (search.utm_term) campaign.keyword = search.utm_term

  // grab userId if present
  let userId = null
  if (cookies.ajs_user_id) userId = cookies.ajs_user_id

  // if no anonymousId, send a randomly generated one
  // otherwise grab existing to include in call to segment
  let anonymousId
  if (cookies.ajs_anonymous_id) {
    anonymousId = cookies.ajs_anonymous_id
  } else {
    anonymousId = uuid.v4()
    res.cookie('ajs_anonymous_id', anonymousId)
  }

  const referrer = req.get('Referrer')
  const userAgent = req.get('User-Agent')

  const properties = {
    search: stringify(search),
    referrer,
    path,
    host,
    url
  }

  const context = {
    campaign,
    userAgent,
    ip
  }

  // send a call to segment
  analytics.page(
    anonymousId,
    userId,
    properties,
    context
  )

  next()
})
```

### Notes

- Server-side pageviews may be redundant with client-side tracking; use a separate source to configure routing independently
- Pass as many Segment Page and Common spec fields as possible for full downstream tool functionality
